concerns_addressed: The cycle-1 cancellation finding is fixed: the native input boundary listens for the cancel event, clears filePickerCommand, and restores title focus without invoking the file callback.
The cancellation regression test verifies a plain unchanged title, no metadata dispatch, no file callback, removal of the picker input, and reopening the same @image definition.

strengths: The file-command variant remains additive and distinct from metadata field commands; existing field command behavior is preserved.
The hidden native input exposes multiple PNG/JPEG selection and selected files are delivered only through onFilesSelected, with no metadata or tracker mutation.
Cancellation is handled at the native input event boundary with cleanup, stale command reset, and focus restoration.
The focused TaskTitleEditor suite passes all 22 tests, including metadata-command coverage and cancel-then-reopen behavior; client typecheck and Biome checks pass.
The audited commit changes only the two task-scoped implementation/test files; no AGENTS.md or unrelated implementation files were changed.
